messages.text: Sprinkler crew found the existing sprinkler main conflicting with the new duct routing at Lobby 101; it's similar to the condition noted in last month's inspection log, but this one isn't shown on Fire Alarm Riser Diagram FA-501. This is urgent -- fire protection crews are standing by. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding up other work currently. Please respond within five business days so we can keep the crew moving.
Reroute to clear the conflict at Lobby 101 per the attached sketch; proceed once clearance is confirmed. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum.
